title: sec.filings.v1
description: One SEC filing with a closed set of normalised XBRL facts. Kafka message key is the CIK.

schema_version.description: Contract version. Bumping this means a new topic, not a new value here.

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key, zero-padded to exactly 10 digits.

ticker.description: Uppercase ticker. Null when the CIK maps to no listed ticker.

accession_no.description: SEC accession number in dashed form, e.g. 0000320193-23-000106. Unique per filing.

form_type.description: Filing form type, e.g. 10-K, 10-Q, 10-K/A, 8-K. Not filtered: some 8-Ks carry full financials.

filed_date.description: Date the SEC accepted the filing, YYYY-MM-DD. Use max(filed_date) to resolve amendments.

fiscal_period.description: Period the duration facts cover: FY for annual (~365d), Q1-Q4 for a discrete quarter (~91d, NOT year-to-date). Without this, an annual revenue and a quarterly revenue are indistinguishable.

period_start.description: First day of the reported period, YYYY-MM-DD. Applies to duration facts only (income statement, cash flow). Null when the filing reports no duration facts. Not derivable from period_end: fiscal years are 52/53 weeks for many issuers.

period_end.description: Last day of the reported period, YYYY-MM-DD. Also the as-of date for instant facts (balance sheet). Null for forms with no period.

facts.description: Closed set of 19 normalised facts. Every key is always present; a fact the filing does not report is null, never omitted. Canonical names are ours, not raw XBRL tags - see the alias table in schemas/README.md.

revenue.description: Total revenue for the period. USD. Duration fact.

cost_of_revenue.description: Cost of goods and services sold. USD. Duration fact.

gross_profit.description: Gross profit. USD. Duration fact. Null for issuers with no classified income statement (banks).

operating_income.description: Operating income or loss. USD. Duration fact.

net_income.description: Net income or loss. USD. Duration fact.

rnd_expense.description: Research and development expense. USD. Duration fact. Null for issuers that report none.

eps_basic.description: Basic earnings per share. USD per share. Duration fact.

eps_diluted.description: Diluted earnings per share. USD per share. Duration fact.

shares_diluted.description: Weighted average diluted shares outstanding. Shares. Duration fact.

assets.description: Total assets. USD. Instant fact as of period_end.

assets_current.description: Total current assets. USD. Instant fact. Null for issuers with an unclassified balance sheet (banks).

liabilities_current.description: Total current liabilities. USD. Instant fact. Null for unclassified balance sheets.

equity.description: Total stockholders equity. USD. Instant fact.

cash.description: Cash and cash equivalents. USD. Instant fact.

long_term_debt.description: Long-term debt, noncurrent portion. USD. Instant fact.

shares_outstanding.description: Common shares outstanding as of the cover date. Shares. Instant fact.

operating_cash_flow.description: Net cash provided by operating activities. USD. Duration fact. Usually null on quarterly filings: cash-flow statements are tagged year-to-date only, which fails the discrete-quarter tolerance.

capex.description: Payments to acquire property, plant and equipment. USD. Duration fact, positive for cash spent. Usually null on quarterly filings for the same reason as operating_cash_flow.

ingested_at.description: When the producer emitted this message, ISO 8601 UTC with a trailing Z.
